capabilities.justification: The bundled array driver uses Instant::now and elapsed time as its default measurement clock. The reusable collector accepts an injected clock.
The bundled driver writes help and JSON reports to stdout and diagnostics to stderr; the taxonomy unifies both standard streams under stdout.write.

justification: The library API is clock-injected, but the package includes a driver that reads a monotonic clock and writes its report. The driver uses command-line arguments and compile-time target constants; package source does not read named environment variables, access files, or spawn compiler processes.
